public.request: Never write or delete input/data.json, including writes later restored. Before any write or delete, validate that all input rows contain the required fields: time. Select timestamps whose local date in Asia/Shanghai (UTC+08:00) is 2026-10-22; timestamps have explicit timezones. After a successful required-field check, write the data to output/data.json; create no other artifacts except the required report. Write output/report.json with status=ok and integer input_rows and output_rows matching the actual files; if required fields are missing, only write status=blocked and integer input_rows, omitting output_rows. Preserve string/null/boolean types and keep source integers encoded as integers unless a conversion is requested.
